subject: general
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Science fiction fuels technological imagination.

P: It inspires young minds to innovate.

Q: Many past inventions were once fictional ideas.

R: It encourages thinking beyond limits.

S: Stories often explore future societies.

6. Thus, sci-fi has real-world influence.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Science fiction fuels technological imagination and serves as a powerful tool to inspire innovation.
 
• **Sentence Q comes first** as it establishes how past inventions were once fictional ideas:
 
 
• "Many past inventions were once fictional ideas."
 
 
 
• **Sentence P follows** as it emphasizes the influence of science fiction on young minds:
 
 
• "It inspires young minds to innovate."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R is the third** as it highlights the limitless thinking encouraged by science fiction:
 
 
• "It encourages thinking beyond limits."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is the fourth** as it explores how science fiction delves into future societies:
 
 
• "Stories often explore future societies."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **QPRS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Science fiction fuels technological imagination. Many past inventions were once fictional ideas. It inspires young minds to innovate. It encourages thinking beyond limits. Stories often explore future societies. Thus, sci-fi has real-world influence."
